questions: Capability #17 doubles c_comp for one node, and it is the one row whose loss moves this fight far (9.4 s on 15 %). Should a Power share row exist beside it, or should the capability be priced as a keystone?
Does a technique "more" keyed to the beast form reach a companion hit? The Walking Stick Method assumes it does.
Full Trough gives +40 L4 for one node and a feed bill four times what is due, far above any catalogue L4 size. Is a stone price enough?
